ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What could happen that would increase the number of krill?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram. The position near the lower center of the image is labeled “krill”, and below it is labeled “phytoplankton”. The arrow from “phytoplankton” to “krill” indicates that krill feed on phytoplankton or rely on phytoplankton as a food source. Reasoning: The question asks what situation would increase the number of krill. According to the rules of a food web, if an animal’s food increases, its number may increase. Therefore, an increase in phytoplankton would increase the number of krill.
